correctness.rationale: Exact Jordan decomposition and unit-modulus complete multiplicativity reduce T_a to a positive floor-square sum; a second Möbius divisor convolution yields F_a(x)=xB(a)+O(log^2(2x)) uniformly, since floor errors are bounded by H_x^2 and the omitted absolute-convergence tail by O(log x). The e^{-2} convolution sums the error absolutely and has mean coefficient 1/zeta(3). The constant equals a convergent nonnegative quotient series, and the upper bound 3 plus unique equality case follow from triangle inequality and the Euler harmonic sum evaluated by an integral. Exact finite test paths verify three identities and phase conjugation; no finite test is treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is an analytically natural weighted GCD quadratic mean prompted by a 2026 Möbius case, and it resolves the entire unimodular completely multiplicative class rather than a narrow arbitrary parameter value. A uniform logarithmic-squared remainder, a positive explicit coefficient, and the unique global maximizer at the constant vector provide qualitative and quantitative structure. The natural Liouville and complex twist cases are covered; limitations for non-unit weights and optimal errors are stated.
